explanation: Noisy sensor (0.02) with coarse dt=0.02, light cart (0.5kg) and initial offset (v=0.5, theta=0.2) causes state-feedback controller to saturate at force_limit and drive cart to high velocity (~10.9 m/s). The saturated bang-bang-like action pumps energy faster than the pole dynamics can be stabilized, so theta diverges from -0.60 (step10) to -0.789 (step11) to -0.988 (step12), breaching pole_upright. Likely cause: controller gains adapted to plant but not robust to combined sensor noise + large dt discretization + saturation, leading to destabilizing positive feedback.
